record.one_liner: Google Workspace-native CRM with a REST developer API.
record.auth_notes: API key (user token plus user email headers) generated in System settings > API Keys; OAuth 2.0 preferred for partner integrations.
record.access_notes: Key generated in-app; docs do not state plan requirements; Copper is paid with a trial (not confirmed on opened pages).
record.api_notes: Leads, People, Companies, Opportunities, Projects, Tasks, Activities, Custom Fields, Webhooks.

record.one_liner: B2B support platform with a REST API (SDKs in TS/Python/Go) and an official OAuth-only hosted MCP.
record.auth_notes: Admin-created Bearer API tokens (Settings > Integrations & dev > API), region-specific, non-expiring; MCP is OAuth-only.
record.access_notes: Need an existing Pylon tenant and an Admin to create tokens; no self-serve signup or plan info found.
record.api_notes: Issues, accounts, contacts and more; TS/Python/Go SDKs and experimental CLI; breadth inferred from docs summary.
record.blocker: no self-serve signup; need paying/sales-onboarded tenant
record.human_reason: Could not find any page stating how a new developer gets a Pylon tenant or plan requirements for API/trial.

record.one_liner: Free Slack-like chat with API-key add-on and OAuth app SDK.
record.auth_notes: API-key add-on (all plans) or OAuth2 for apps (client ID/secret from app manifest).
record.access_notes: Install API add-on and generate key; available on all plans for Owner/Admin/Member.
record.api_notes: Send/reply/delete messages, reactions, create channels, list channels/messages; 1000 req/min.

record.auth_notes: Access tokens; permanent system-user token with whatsapp_business_messaging/management permissions.
record.access_notes: Meta developer account + app + test number is free; production use needs business portfolio, number registration, and app review/business verification for others' accounts; conversation pricing applies.
record.api_notes: Messaging, templates, phone numbers, webhooks, media.
record.blocker: Meta app review/business verification for production

record.auth_notes: 3-legged OAuth only; scopes r_ads, rw_ads, r_ads_reporting; no client credentials for marketing.
record.access_notes: Advertising API product must be approved for the developer app (Development Tier, up to 5 ad accounts); further tiers need review.
record.api_notes: Ad accounts, campaigns, creatives, reporting, organizations.

record.one_liner: Pinterest API v5 with OAuth2 and newly announced MCP.
record.auth_notes: OAuth 2.0 authorization code; trial tokens expire in 24h.
record.access_notes: Business account; app request reviewed for Trial access, then Standard access upgrade review for production.
record.human_reason: MCP availability/URL from third-party blog; Pinterest announcement page gave no details; GA status unclear.

record.one_liner: Adobe Commerce/Magento platform (self-hosted PaaS and SaaS) with REST and GraphQL APIs.
record.auth_notes: PaaS: admin/customer token auth, OAuth 1.0a integrations, session; SaaS: IMS OAuth2 server-to-server (client credentials, commerce.accs scope) via Adobe Developer Console.
record.access_notes: Each deployment is licensed/self-hosted per merchant (Adobe Commerce or open-source Magento); credentials created per instance in admin or Adobe Developer Console with org admin.
record.api_notes: REST /V1 resources for catalog, customers, orders, etc.; GraphQL storefront; the fetched page did not mention GraphQL.
record.blocker: per-instance deployment and two auth models

record.one_liner: SEO toolset with API v3 and hosted MCP.
record.auth_notes: API v3 uses API key as Bearer token; hosted MCP uses OAuth consent that mints a separate MCP-scoped key (per search results).
record.access_notes: API v3 and MCP require Lite or higher subscription; custom endpoints Enterprise only; units are metered.
record.api_notes: API v3 over site explorer, keywords, rank tracker, etc.; some endpoints free; v2 deprecated.
record.human_reason: docs.ahrefs.com pages returned 404; auth and MCP endpoint details come from search snippets, not an opened primary page.

record.one_liner: Aggregates 30+ data vendors for contact, phone and company enrichment.
record.auth_notes: API key in x-api-key header (site shows two header names).
record.access_notes: Docs do not say how to obtain a key; site funnels to Book a Call with founders; no free trial mentioned.
record.api_notes: Prospector, contact/phone/company enrichment, search, email verification, job change, reporting.
record.human_reason: No documented self-serve key path; pricing/sign-up not confirmed; no MCP found in the pages opened.

record.one_liner: Issue tracking and project management for software teams.
record.auth_notes: OAuth2 (auth code and client credentials, Bearer); personal API keys (confirmed via MCP page, not auth page).
record.access_notes: OAuth apps created in workspace settings; API keys by users; plan gating not stated.
record.api_notes: GraphQL API at api.linear.app/graphql plus SDK.

record.one_liner: Online payments, billing, invoicing and payouts platform.
record.auth_notes: Secret/restricted API keys (sk_/rk_) as Bearer-style auth; OAuth used for MCP and Stripe Apps/Connect; agent-tagged restricted keys supported.
record.access_notes: Free account; sandbox with test keys is self-serve; live keys after account activation.
record.api_notes: Very broad REST API (customers, charges, PaymentIntents, subscriptions, invoices, Connect, Issuing, Treasury, Tax, etc.) plus v2 APIs.

record.one_liner: FX forensic audit API that scores bank/card FX rates against live mid-market.
record.auth_notes: Production key (ipx_live_...) sent as Authorization: Bearer in REST and MCP.
record.access_notes: Account signup is free with only 3 lifetime audits; API plans start at $99/mo (Developer, 100 audits, sandbox).
record.api_notes: Few endpoints: POST /v1/audit and score-config GET/PUT/DELETE; docs oddly list a Supabase function base URL.

record.one_liner: Google's AI notebook; Enterprise edition has a notebooks REST API.
record.auth_notes: Google user OAuth access token (e.g. gcloud auth print-access-token) as Bearer; user account, not service account.
record.access_notes: Needs Gemini/NotebookLM Enterprise license plus Cloud NotebookLM User role and Google Cloud project.
record.api_notes: v1alpha Pre-GA notebooks methods: create, get, list recent, batchDelete, share. No source/content/chat endpoints seen.
